title: Chelsea Heights
content:
Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Chelsea Heights

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Chelsea Heights. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

We know what the south-east's heat, UV and hailstorms do to a roof over the years, so we quote on what your home actually needs. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Chelsea Heights: What We Commonly See

Set just back from the bay near the wetlands, Chelsea Heights is a low-lying suburb of post-war brick homes and newer builds. Most of the older homes have roofs that are faded and worn after years of sun, and many are due for replacement.

Being a little inland softens the salt compared with the beachfront, but the breeze still carries it, and low-lying ground makes good drainage important. The jobs we are called out for most in Chelsea Heights are refixing cracked ridge capping, re-roofing worn-out roofs, clearing and replacing overflowing gutters, and fixing leaks where flashings or valleys have failed.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Chelsea Heights

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Chelsea Heights homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and built to handle Melbourne's heat, UV and hailstorms, in a colour that suits your home.

If you are thinking about going metal, our tile to tin service is a popular way to lose the weight and the upkeep. If you are unsure whether you need a full re-roof, we will inspect the roof, show you what we find and give you an honest recommendation.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Chelsea Heights

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that let water in: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. After a hailstorm or a run of hot summers these are often the first things to fail, and we trace each leak back to its real source rather than patching the ceiling stain.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Chelsea Heights

There is no standard price for a roof, because no two roofs are the same. The size and pitch of the roof, the profile and colour of the steel, the amount of guttering, flashings and downpipes, and the access to the site all affect the quote. We inspect the roof, put the price in writing and explain every line.

Our Chelsea Heights Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Chelsea Heights Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Browse the COLORBOND® colour chart to start picturing your new roof.

Chelsea Heights Roofing FAQs

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.

Suburbs We Service Near Chelsea Heights

We also work on roofs in nearby Chelsea, Edithvale, Bonbeach, Carrum and Patterson Lakes.
